title: Virtua Fighter CG Portrait Series Vol. 4: Pai Chan
native_title: バーチャ・ファイター ＣＧポートレート・シリーズ Ｖｏｌ．４ 「パイ・チェン」
overview:
Character CG from Virtua Fighter and an image song blend together beautifully...

Volume 4 of the CG Portrait Series is devoted to Pai Chan. Newly made computer graphics follow her through daily life - stretching at home, cycling down narrow streets, relaxing at a cafe and sitting on a film set - in a sequence staged to her image song "Oh, My Shinin' Star", a single from the Virtua Fighter 2 vocal album Dancing Shadows.

Choose "Karaoke" and the lyrics appear on screen so you can sing along.

- Original CG portraits of Pai Chan
- Image song with a karaoke mode

「バーチャファイター」のキャラクターCGとイメージソングが華麗に融合する…
